answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 360 POA bond locked 125 days, one bond per device key, so a farm cannot split one bond across a thousand fake accounts. Each agent tends one orchard plot of weekly jobs chained in order, each job building on the last. Three falcon auditors drawn by lot each month re-run one job live and check the plot ledger. A clean record earns a beacon badge paid work requires; a forged entry or shared key burns the bond, revokes the badge, and bars the agent for a year.
